source.paper: Meheust et al. 2024, Human infrastructures correspond to higher Adelie penguin breeding success and growth rate

study_frame_from_paper.breeding_success_definition: fledged chicks F_{i+1} / breeding pairs A_i

purpose: Directly test whether the denominator-separated short-lag performance-to-redistribution pattern observed at Palmer is reproduced in an independent Adelie colony system using the authors' deposited colony-year data.

frozen_analysis_if_gate_opens.source_identity: Use the deposited author-processed colony identities exactly as provided; do not reconstruct colony boundaries from maps.

performance.year_relative_state: Within each breeding season, z-standardize BS across eligible colonies; call this S_i,t.
performance.island_year_sensitivity: If island identifiers are available, repeat after z-standardizing within island x year.

growth.g_i,u: log1p(N_i,u+1) - log1p(N_i,u) for adjacent annual counts only
growth.relative_growth: Subtract the annual mean growth across all eligible colonies in the primary analysis; island-year demeaning is the prespecified sensitivity if island identity is available.

published_replication_check.role: First reproduce the paper's reported lag-correlation signs using the deposited data before fitting the new model.
published_replication_check.failure_rule: If the deposited data and published code cannot reproduce the reported lag signs within obvious deterministic processing choices, STOP for provenance audit before the new model.

primary_bias_resistant_model.endpoint_alignment: S_i,t predicts redistribution during t+1 -> t+2, corresponding to the Palmer denominator-separated lag-2 endpoint.
primary_bias_resistant_model.formula: relative_growth_i,t+1 = beta * S_i,t + gamma * z(log1p(N_i,t+1)) + colony fixed effect + error
primary_bias_resistant_model.permutation_null: Permute S_i,t among all eligible colonies within predictor year t while preserving missingness, future growth, current size and colony identity.
primary_bias_resistant_model.p_value: one-sided upper-tail Monte Carlo p with +1 correction

secondary.same_interval: Report S_i,t -> t to t+1 relative growth as mechanically coupled/descriptive only.
secondary.next_next_interval: Report S_i,t -> t+2 to t+3 relative growth using the same controls and permutation family.
secondary.leave_one_island_out: If island is available, report observed primary beta after dropping each island.
secondary.exclude_station_core: Only if the deposited data provide an explicit author-defined station/core grouping; otherwise do not construct one.

decision.direct_external_replication: Primary beta > 0 with p <= 0.05 after successfully reproducing the published lag-sign audit.
decision.non_replication: Primary endpoint estimable but fails the directional/inference rule.
decision.blocked: Raw deposited data cannot be accessed or required schema/information is unavailable.

claim_boundaries: The published 2024 lag correlation is literature triangulation, not our independent reanalysis.
Do not describe direct replication as successful while the Figshare gate remains blocked.
Do not infer public-information use from a positive aggregate colony-level coefficient alone.
Do not tune lags, demeaning scale, colony definitions, controls, thresholds or alpha after raw values are opened.
The paper's own colony merging must be inherited rather than modified post hoc.
